## Finding R1 — `extension.ts` Exceeds 500-Line File Size Limit

**Severity:** Policy violation (non-blocking)
**Policy:** `.claude/rules/general-code-change.md` — "No production code, test code, or reusable script file may exceed 500 lines."
**File:** `extensions/drm-copilot/src/extension.ts`
**Line count on `main`:** 538 (pre-existing violation)
**Line count on branch:** 673 (worsened by 135 lines)

**Root cause:** The file registers all VS Code command handlers in a single activation function. Over multiple features, this file has grown beyond the 500-line limit. This branch added the `newClaudeWorktreeSession` handler expansion, `pyprojectHasPoetry` helper, and associated imports/constants.

**Recommended remediation:** Extract each command handler or related group of handlers into dedicated registration modules (e.g., `worktree-session-command.ts`, `pr-context-command.ts`) and import them into `extension.ts`. The activation function in `extension.ts` should serve as a thin coordinator only.
